title: The value of clean water: Experimental evidence from rural India
abstract: Over 2 billion people lack clean drinking water. Existing solutions face high costs (piped water) or low demand (point-of-use chlorine). Using a 60,000 household cluster-randomized experiment, we test an alternative approach: decentralized treatment and home delivery of clean water to the rural poor. At low prices, take-up exceeds 90 percent, sustained throughout the experiment. High prices reduce take-up but are privately profitable. We experimentally recover revealed-preference measures of valuation. Willingness-to-pay is several times higher than prior indirect estimates; willingness-to-accept is larger and exceeds marginal cost. Self-reported health measures improve accordingly. On a cost-per-DALY basis, free water delivery regimes appear highly cost effective. (JEL I12, O12, O13, O18, Q25, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 全球有超过20亿人缺乏清洁饮用水。现有解决方案要么成本高昂（管道供水），要么需求低迷（使用点氯消毒）。通过一项覆盖6万户家庭的整群随机实验，我们检验了一种替代方案：向农村贫困人口提供分散式处理并上门配送清洁水。在低价格下，采用率超过90%，并在整个实验期间持续保持。高价格会降低采用率，但对私营部门而言仍然有利可图。我们通过实验获得了显示偏好的估值指标。支付意愿比先前的间接估计高出数倍；受偿意愿更大，且超过了边际成本。自我报告的健康指标也随之改善。按每伤残调整生命年（DALY）的成本计算，免费送水方案显得极具成本效益。（JEL I12, O12, O13, O18, Q25, Q51, Q53）

title: Decision-oriented benchmarking to transform AI weather forecast access: Application to the Indian monsoon
abstract: Artificial intelligence weather prediction (AIWP) models now often outperform traditional physics-based models on common metrics while requiring orders-of-magnitude less computing resources and time. Open-access AIWP models thus hold promise as transformational tools for helping low- and middle-income populations make decisions in the face of high-impact weather shocks. Yet, current approaches to evaluating AIWP models focus mainly on aggregated meteorological metrics without considering local stakeholders' needs in decision-oriented, operational frameworks. Here, we introduce such a framework that connects meteorology, AI, and social sciences. As an example, we apply it to the 150-year-old problem of Indian monsoon forecasting, focusing on benefits to rain-fed agriculture, which is highly susceptible to climate change. AIWP models skillfully predict an agriculturally relevant onset index at regional scales weeks in advance when evaluated out-of-sample using deterministic and probabilistic metrics. This framework informed a government-led effort in 2025 to send 38 million Indian farmers AI-based monsoon onset forecasts, which captured an unusual weeks-long pause in monsoon progression. This decision-oriented benchmarking framework provides a key component of a blueprint for harnessing the power of AIWP models to help large vulnerable populations adapt to weather shocks in the face of climate variability and change.
abstract_zh: 人工智能天气预报（AIWP）模型现在在常见指标上往往优于传统的基于物理的模型，同时所需计算资源和时间少了几个数量级。开放获取的AIWP模型因此有望成为变革性工具，帮助低收入和中等收入人群在面对高影响天气冲击时做出决策。然而，目前评估AIWP模型的方法主要关注汇总的气象指标，而未考虑当地利益相关者在以决策为导向的业务框架中的需求。在此，我们提出了这样一个将气象学、人工智能和社会科学联系起来的框架。作为示例，我们将其应用于已有150年历史的印度季风预报问题，重点关注对雨养农业的益处，而雨养农业对气候变化高度敏感。当使用确定性和概率性指标进行样本外评估时，AIWP模型能够在区域尺度上提前数周准确预测一个与农业相关的季风开始指数。该框架为政府在2025年开展的一项行动提供了依据，该行动向3800万印度农民发送了基于人工智能的季风开始预报，这些预报成功捕捉到了季风推进中一次罕见的长达数周的停滞。这一以决策为导向的基准评估框架，为利用AIWP模型的力量、帮助大量脆弱人群在气候变率和变化面前适应天气冲击的蓝图提供了关键组成部分。

title: Designing probabilistic AI monsoon forecasts to inform agricultural decision-making
abstract: Subsetted AI-based weather prediction (AIWP) forecast datasets for daily precipitation over the Indian region. Daily precipitation is provided on a 2° × 2° spatial grid, obtained via conservative regridding from each model’s native resolution. Daily precipitation from the Meteorological Department (IMD) at the same 2° ×2° resolution is also provided. The datasets span multiple analysis periods and are organized as yearly NetCDF (.nc) files.
abstract_zh: 对印度地区日降水的人工智能天气预报（AIWP）预测数据集进行了子集提取。日降水数据以2°×2°的空间网格提供，通过对各模型原始分辨率数据进行保守重网格化获得。同一2°×2°分辨率的印度气象部（IMD）日降水数据也一并提供。数据集涵盖多个分析时段，并按年份组织为NetCDF（.nc）文件。

title: Estimating Global Agricultural Impacts of Climate Change Accounting for Adaptation
Long-range forecasts as climate adaptation: Experimental evidence from developing-country agriculture
Up in smoke: California's greenhouse gas reductions could be wiped out by 2020 wildfires
abstract: In this short communication, we estimate that California's wildfire carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) emissions from 2020 are approximately two times higher than California's total greenhouse gas (GHG) emission reductions since 2003. Without considering future vegetation regrowth, CO2e emissions from the 2020 wildfires could be the second most important source in the state above either industry or electrical power generation. Regrowth may partly of fully occur over a long period, but due to exigencies of the climate crisis most of the regrowth will not occur quickly enough to avert greater than 1.5 degrees of warming. Global monetized damages caused by CO2e from in 2020 wildfire emissions amount to some $7.1 billion USD. Our analysis suggests that significant societal benefits could accrue from larger investments in improved forest management and stricter controls on new development in fire-prone areas at the wildland-urban interface.
abstract_zh: 在这篇简短通讯中，我们估计，加利福尼亚州2020年野火的二氧化碳当量（CO2e）排放量约为该州自2003年以来温室气体（GHG）减排总量的两倍。在不考虑未来植被再生的情况下，2020年野火的CO2e排放可能成为该州第二大排放源，排放量高于工业和发电行业。植被再生可能会部分或完全发生，但历时较长；而由于气候危机的紧迫性，大部分再生不会足够迅速，无法避免升温超过1.5摄氏度。2020年野火排放的CO2e所造成的全球货币化损失约为71亿美元。我们的分析表明，若在野火与城市交界地带的易火区域加大对森林管理改善的投入并严格控制新开发，可能带来可观的社会效益。

title: Valuing the global mortality consequences of climate change accounting for adaptation costs and benefits
abstract: Using 40 countries’ subnational data, we estimate age-specific mortality-temperature relationships and extrapolate them to countries without data today and into a future with climate change. We uncover a U-shaped relationship where extre6me cold and hot temperatures increase mortality rates, especially for the elderly. Critically, this relationship is flattened by higher incomes and adaptation to local climate. Using a revealed-preference approach to recover unobserved adaptation costs, we estimate that the mean global increase in mortality risk due to climate change, accounting for adaptation benefits and costs, is valued at roughly 3.2% of global GDP in 2100 under a high-emissions scenario. Notably, today’s cold locations are projected to benefit, while today’s poor and hot locations have large projected damages. Finally, our central estimates indicate that the release of an additional ton of CO2 today will cause mortality-related damages of $36.6 under a high-emissions scenario, with an interquartile range accounting for both econometric and climate uncertainty of [−$7.8, $73.0]. These empirically grounded estimates exceed the previous literature’s estimates by an order of magnitude.
abstract_zh: 利用40个国家的次国家级数据，我们估计了分年龄组的死亡率与温度之间的关系，并将其外推至当前缺乏数据的国家以及气候变化背景下的未来情景。我们发现了一种U形关系：极端的低温和高温会提高死亡率，对老年人尤为明显。关键在于，这一关系会因收入水平提高和当地气候适应而趋于平缓。我们采用显示性偏好方法（revealed-preference approach）来推算不可观测的适应成本，估计在高排放情景下，考虑适应收益与适应成本之后，气候变化导致的全球平均死亡风险增加在2100年约相当于全球GDP的3.2%。值得注意的是，当前较为寒冷的地区预计将从中受益，而当前贫穷且炎热的地区预计将遭受巨大损失。最后，我们的中心估计表明，在高排放情景下，当前每排放一吨CO2将造成36.6美元的死亡率相关损害，若同时考虑计量经济学不确定性与气候不确定性，其四分位距为[−7.8美元，73.0美元]。这些基于经验证据的估计，比以往文献的估计高出一个数量级。

title: Labor Disutility in a Warmer World: The Impact of Climate Change on the Global Workforce
venue: Revise & Resubmit, Journal of Political Economy
abstract: This paper develops the first globally comprehensive and empirically grounded estimates of worker disutility due to future temperature increases caused by climate change. Harmonizing daily worker-level data from seven countries representing nearly a third of the world's population, we first evaluate the causal effect of daily temperature on labor supply, recovering an inverted U-shaped relationship where extreme cold and hot temperatures lead to labor supply losses for workers in weather-exposed industries. We then develop the first micro-founded, global estimates for how future climate change will impact workers, accounting for expected shifts in the global workforce towards less weather-exposed industries. Interpreting labor supply impacts of climate change through a simple theoretical framework, we monetize the implied disutility to workers of a warmer climate, a welfare cost not captured in any existing estimates. Under a high emissions scenario, we estimate the increase in labor disutility is valued at roughly 1.8% of global GDP in 2099, with damages being especially large in today’s poor and/or hot locations while cold locations benefit. Finally, we estimate that the release of an additional ton of CO2 today will cause expected labor disutility damages of $17.0 under a high emissions scenario and $10.8 under a moderate scenario, using a 2% discount rate that is justified by US Treasury rates over the last two decades. Accounting for uncertainty in these marginal damages when individuals are risk averse increases their value by 31% (high emissions scenario) and 62% (moderate scenario) under a standard parameterization of the utility function.
abstract_zh: 本文首次对未来气温升高（由气候变化引起）给劳动者带来的负效用进行了全球范围内的全面且基于经验证据的估计。我们协调了来自七个国家的逐日劳动者层面数据，这些国家的人口约占世界总人口的三分之一。我们首先评估了日气温对劳动供给的因果效应，得到一种倒U形关系：在受天气影响较大的行业中，极端的低温和高温都会导致劳动者的劳动供给减少。随后，我们首次基于微观基础建立了全球范围内的估计，考察未来气候变化将如何影响劳动者，并考虑全球劳动力向受天气影响较小的行业转移的预期变化。我们通过一个简单的理论框架来解释气候变化对劳动供给的影响，并将由此隐含的、更温暖气候给劳动者带来的负效用货币化，这是现有估计均未涵盖的福利成本。在高排放情景下，我们估计2099年劳动负效用的增加相当于全球GDP的约1.8%，其中损失在当前贫穷和/或炎热的地区尤为严重，而寒冷地区则从中受益。最后，我们估计，在高排放情景下，当前每排放一吨CO2将造成17.0美元的预期劳动负效用损失，在中等排放情景下为10.8美元，贴现率取2%，该贴现率由过去二十年美国国债收益率予以支持。若风险厌恶型个体的不确定性被纳入考虑，并采用效用函数的标准参数化设定，则在高排放情景下其价值将提高31%，在中等排放情景下提高62%。

title: ENSO impacts child undernutrition in the global tropics
The Social Cost of Global Energy Consumption due to Climate Change
Inequality and the Biosphere

title: Estimating economic damage from climate change in the United States
abstract: Estimates of climate change damage are central to the design of climate policies. Here, we develop a flexible architecture for computing damages that integrates climate science, econometric analyses, and process models. We use this approach to construct spatially explicit, probabilistic, and empirically derived estimates of economic damage in the United States from climate change. The combined value of market and nonmarket damage across analyzed sectors-agriculture, crime, coastal storms, energy, human mortality, and labor-increases quadratically in global mean temperature, costing roughly 1.2% of gross domestic product per +1°C on average. Importantly, risk is distributed unequally across locations, generating a large transfer of value northward and westward that increases economic inequality. By the late 21st century, the poorest third of counties are projected to experience damages between 2 and 20% of county income (90% chance) under business-as-usual emissions (Representative Concentration Pathway 8.5).
abstract_zh: 气候变化损害的估计是气候政策设计的核心。本文构建了一个灵活的框架，用于计算损害，该框架整合了气候科学、计量经济分析和过程模型。我们利用这一方法，构建了美国因气候变化而产生的经济损害的空间显式、概率性且基于经验推导的估计。在所分析的各部门（农业、犯罪、沿海风暴、能源、人类死亡率和劳动力）中，市场与非市场损害的合计价值随全球平均气温呈二次方增长，平均而言，每升温1°C将造成约相当于国内生产总值1.2%的损失。重要的是，风险在不同地区间分布不均，导致价值大规模地向北和向西转移，进而加剧了经济不平等。到21世纪末，最贫穷的三分之一县预计将遭受相当于县收入2%至20%的损害（置信水平为90%），该结果基于照常排放情景（代表性浓度路径8.5，RCP 8.5）。

title: Extreme air pollution in global megacities
Economic Risks of Climate Change: An American Prospectus
abstract: Climate change threatens the economy of the United States through increased flooding and storm damage, climate-driven changes in crop yields, disruptions in labor productivity, crime, and public health and heat-related strains on energy systems. Combining current data with state-of-the-art climate models, econometric research on human responses to climate, and cutting-edge private sector risk assessment tools, this prospectus crafts a game-changing analysis of the risks of future climate change in specific U.S. regions and sectors. This work is based on a critically acclaimed independent assessment of climate change's economic risks commissioned by the Risky Business Project. With contributions from Karen Fisher-Vanden (Penn State University), Michael Greenstone (MIT), Geoffrey Heal (Columbia Business School), Michael Oppenheimer (Princeton University), and Nicholas Stern and Bob Ward (Grantham Research Institute), as well as a foreword from the nation's leading voices on environmental action, the prospectus speaks to scientists, researchers, scholars, activists, and policymakers. It depicts the distribution of escalating climate change risk across the country and anticipates its effects on aspects as varied as coastal property and crime. Beautifully illustrated and accessibly written, Economic Risks of Climate Change is an essential tool for helping businesses and governments prepare for the future
abstract_zh: 气候变化通过洪水和风暴损害加剧、气候驱动的作物产量变化、劳动生产率扰动、犯罪，以及公共卫生问题和高温对能源系统造成的压力，威胁着美国经济。本报告结合当前数据、最先进的气候模型、关于人类对气候反应的计量经济学研究以及前沿的私营部门风险评估工具，对美国特定地区和部门未来气候变化风险进行了具有开创性意义的分析。本研究基于一项备受好评的独立评估，该评估是由“风险商业项目”（Risky Business Project）委托完成的，关于气候变化的经济风险。来自宾夕法尼亚州立大学的Karen Fisher-Vanden、麻省理工学院的Michael Greenstone、哥伦比亚大学商学院的Geoffrey Heal、普林斯顿大学的Michael Oppenheimer，以及格兰瑟姆研究所的Nicholas Stern和Bob Ward均参与了贡献，此外还有该国领先的环境行动人士撰写的序言。本报告面向科学家、研究人员、学者、活动人士和政策制定者，描绘了气候变化风险在全国范围内的分布情况，并预测了其对沿海房地产和犯罪等多方面的影响。《气候变化的经济风险》图文并茂、叙述通俗易懂，是帮助企业和政府为未来做好准备的重要工具

title: Geography, Depreciation, and Growth
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings 105(5): 252-56

title: Satellites, Self-reports, and Submersion: Exposure to Floods in Bangladesh
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings 105(5): 232-36
abstract: A burgeoning “Climate-Economy” literature has uncovered many effects of changes in temperature and precipitation on economic activity, but has made considerably less progress in modeling the effects of other associated phenomena, like natural disasters. We develop new, objective data on floods, focusing on Bangladesh. We show that rainfall and self-reported exposure are weak proxies for true flood exposure. These data allow us to study adaptation, giving accurate measures of both long-term averages and short term variation in exposure. This is important in studying climate change impacts, as people will not only experience new exposures, but also experience them differently.
abstract_zh: 大量“气候-经济”文献揭示了气温和降水变化对经济活动的诸多影响，但在建模其他相关现象（如自然灾害）的影响方面进展相对较少。我们以孟加拉国为研究对象，构建了关于洪水的新的客观数据。我们发现，降雨量和自我报告的暴露程度都是真实洪水暴露的较弱代理指标。这些数据使我们能够研究适应行为，并准确衡量长期平均暴露水平和短期暴露波动。这对于研究气候变化影响至关重要，因为人们不仅会面临新的暴露，还会以不同的方式经历这些暴露。

title: Smallholder farmer cropping decisions related to climate variability across multiple regions
abstract: A long history of household-level research has provided important local-level insights into climate adaptation strategies in the agricultural sector. It remains unclear to what extent these strategies are generalizable or vary across regions. In this study we ask about three potential key factors influencing farming households’ ability to adapt: access to weather information, household and agricultural production-related assets, and participation in local social institutions. We use a 12-country data set from sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia to explore the links between these three potential drivers of agricultural change and the likelihood that farmers made farm-associated changes, such as adopting improved crop varieties, increasing fertilizer use, investing in improved land management practices, and changing the timing of agricultural activities. We find evidence that access to weather information, assets, and participation in social institutions are associated with households that have reported making farming changes in recent years, although these results vary across countries and types of practices. Understanding these drivers and outcomes of farm-associated changes across different socio-economic and environmental conditions is critical for ongoing dialogues for climate-resilient strategies and policies for increasing the adaptive capacity of smallholders under climate change.
abstract_zh: 长期以来，家庭层面的研究为农业部门的气候适应策略提供了重要的地方性见解。然而，这些策略在多大程度上具有普遍适用性，或在不同地区之间存在多大差异，目前仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们探讨了影响农户适应能力的三个潜在关键因素：获取天气信息的渠道、家庭与农业生产相关的资产，以及参与当地社会制度的情况。我们使用来自撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚12个国家的数据集，考察这三个潜在驱动因素与农户进行农业相关变革的可能性之间的联系，这些变革包括采用改良作物品种、增加化肥使用、投资改良土地管理措施，以及调整农业活动的时间安排。我们发现，获取天气信息、资产以及参与社会制度，与近年来报告进行了农业变革的家庭存在关联，不过这些结果因国家和做法类型的不同而有所差异。在不同的社会经济和环境条件下，理解这些农业变革的驱动因素和结果，对于正在进行的关于气候适应型战略的讨论，以及提升小农在气候变化下适应能力的政策制定至关重要。

title: The Causal Effect of Environmental Catastrophe on Long-Run Economic Growth: Evidence from 6,700 cyclones
venue: Revise & Resubmit, Journal of Political Economy (NBER Working Paper No. 20352)
abstract: Does the environment have a causal effect on economic development? Using meteorological data, we reconstruct every country's exposure to the universe of tropical cyclones during 1950-2008.We exploit random within-country year-to-year variation in cyclone strikes to identify the causal effect of environmental disasters on long-run growth. We compare each country's growth rate to itself in the years immediately before and after exposure, accounting for the distribution of cyclones in preceding years. The data reject hypotheses that disasters stimulate growth or that short-run losses disappear following migrations or transfers of wealth. Instead, we find robust evidence that national incomes decline, relative to their pre-disaster trend, and do not recover within twenty years. Both rich and poor countries exhibit this response, with losses magnified in countries with less historical cyclone experience. Income losses arise from a small but persistent suppression of annual growth rates spread across the fifteen years following disaster, generating large and significant cumulative effects: a 90th percentile event reduces per capita incomes by 7.4% two decades later, effectively undoing 3.7 years of average development. The gradual nature of these losses render them inconspicuous to a casual observer, however simulations indicate that they have dramatic influence over the long-run development of countries that are endowed with regular or continuous exposure to disaster. Linking these results to projections of future cyclone activity, we estimate that under conservative discounting assumptions the present discounted cost of "business as usual" climate change is roughly $9.7 trillion larger than previously thought.
abstract_zh: 环境是否对经济发展具有因果效应？我们利用气象数据，重建了1950年至2008年间每个国家所遭受的全部热带气旋暴露情况。我们利用各国内部逐年热带气旋登陆的随机变化来识别环境灾害对长期增长的因果效应。我们将每个国家在受灾前后数年的增长率与其自身进行比较，同时考虑此前各年热带气旋的分布情况。数据拒绝了“灾害刺激增长”的假设，也拒绝了“短期损失会因移民或财富转移而消失”的假设。相反，我们发现了有力证据表明，国民收入相对于灾前趋势会下降，并且在二十年内都无法恢复。富裕国家和贫穷国家都表现出这一反应，且在历史上热带气旋经历较少的国家，损失会被放大。收入损失源于灾后十五年间年增长率的微小但持续的抑制，由此产生了巨大且显著的累积效应：第90百分位的灾害事件会使二十年后的人均收入减少7.4%，相当于抵消了3.7年的平均发展成果。这些损失是逐步出现的，因此对一般观察者而言不易察觉；然而，模拟结果表明，对于那些长期或持续面临灾害暴露的国家，这些损失对其长期发展具有极大的影响。将这些结果与未来热带气旋活动的预测相联系，我们估计，在保守的贴现假设下，“照常排放”的气候变化所带来的现值成本，比以往认为的大约多出9.7万亿美元。

title: Biophysical and Socioeconomic Factors Associated with Forest Transitions at Multiple Spatial and Temporal Scales
